name: Benicia Certified Farmers Market
tagline: IT’S TIME FOR BENICIA FARMERS MARKET
description: Benicia Certified Farmers Market is a farmers market in 90 First St Benicia, CA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
